parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app location per the restraint rules, regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production method in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). This is the textbook mixed-cluster pattern: the sample-app copy of 'DebugMetricsProvider.updateMetrics' is a local demonstration fixture in 'DebugHUD.swift', not a candidate for shared extraction. Merging the two would couple the production DebugPanel package to sample-app semantics, which is the exact coupling the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
